changelog: New voice command "uppercase" — say "uppercase usa" alone while dictating (or "usa সব বড় হাতের করো") and the word becomes ALL CAPS ("USA"), so acronyms like USA, SP or VIP dictated in small letters can be fixed by voice. "capitalize" only made the first letter big ("Usa"); now the whole word goes big. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
